items.distractor_fact: នៅដំបូលអគារជិតខាង ឧបករណ៍វាស់សីតុណ្ហភាពមួយទៀតបានវាស់បាន {D} អង្សាសេ ក្នុងព្រឹកដដែល។
items.gloss_en: On the roof of a nearby building, another thermometer read {D}°C that same morning.
items.entity_note: a different instrument (thermometer) on a different building's roof, not the garden's own gauge.

items.distractor_fact: ភាគហ៊ុនរបស់ក្រុមហ៊ុនមួយផ្សេងទៀតមានតម្លៃ {D} ដុល្លារ ក្នុងថ្ងៃដដែល។
items.gloss_en: Shares of a different company were priced at {D} dollars that same day.
items.entity_note: a different company's stock, not the one whose price changed.

items.distractor_fact: អាងស្តុកទឹកមួយផ្សេងទៀតនៅតំបន់ជិតខាងមានកម្រិតទឹក {D} ម៉ែត្រ ក្នុងថ្ងៃដដែល។
items.gloss_en: A different reservoir in a nearby area had a water level of {D} meters that same day.
items.entity_note: a different reservoir, not the one whose level changed with the rain.

items.distractor_fact: យន្តហោះគ្មានមនុស្សបើកមួយផ្សេងទៀតមានកម្ពស់ {D} ម៉ែត្រពីដី ក្នុងពេលដដែល។
items.gloss_en: A different drone was flying at an altitude of {D} meters above the ground at the same time.
items.entity_note: a different drone, not the one whose altitude changed during its flight.

items.distractor_fact: កញ្ចប់មួយផ្សេងទៀតនៅក្នុងឃ្លាំងតែមួយមានទម្ងន់ {D} គីឡូក្រាម។
items.gloss_en: A different package in the same warehouse weighed {D} kilograms.
items.entity_note: a different package, not the one that was repacked.

items.distractor_fact: ភូមិជិតខាងមួយទៀតមានចំនួនប្រជាជន {D} នាក់ ក្នុងឆ្នាំដដែល។
items.gloss_en: A neighboring village had a population of {D} people that same year.
items.entity_note: a different village, not the one whose population changed.

items.distractor_fact: ឡានមួយគ្រឿងផ្សេងទៀតបានបើកបរដោយល្បឿន {D} គីឡូម៉ែត្រក្នុងមួយម៉ោង នៅផ្លូវកោងតែមួយ។
items.gloss_en: A different car was traveling at {D} km/h on the same curve.
items.entity_note: a different car, not the one whose speed changed through the curve.

items.distractor_fact: គណនីធនាគាររបស់មិត្តភ័ក្តិនាងម្នាក់ទៀតបានទទួលការដាក់ប្រាក់សរុបចំនួន {D} ដុល្លារ ក្នុងខែដដែល។
items.gloss_en: A friend's bank account received total deposits of {D} dollars that same month.
items.entity_note: a different person's bank account, not hers.

items.distractor_fact: ហាងតូចមួយផ្សេងទៀតនៅតំបន់ជិតខាងមានចំណូលសរុបចំនួន {D} ដុល្លារ ក្នុងខែដដែល។
items.gloss_en: A different small shop in a nearby area had total income of {D} dollars that same month.
items.entity_note: a different shop, not the one whose net result is being asked about.

items.distractor_fact: ផលប័ត្រវិនិយោគរបស់អ្នកវិនិយោគម្នាក់ទៀតមានប្រាក់ចំណេញសរុបចំនួន {D} ដុល្លារ ក្នុងឆ្នាំដដែល។
items.gloss_en: A different investor's portfolio had total gains of {D} dollars that same year.
items.entity_note: a different investor's portfolio, not his.

items.distractor_fact: រថភ្លើងមួយផ្សេងទៀតនៅលើខ្សែផ្លូវខុសគ្នា បានមកដល់ស្ថានីយ៍ជាក់ស្តែងនៅម៉ោងស្មើនឹង {D} គិតជានាទី ដោយប្រកាន់តាមកាលវិភាគផ្ទាល់ខ្លួនរបស់វា។
items.gloss_en: A different train, on a different line, actually arrived at the station at a time equal to {D} minutes, going by its own separate schedule.
items.entity_note: a different train on a different line with its own unstated schedule, not this train's actual-vs-scheduled pair.

items.distractor_fact: ក្នុងអគារមួយផ្សេងទៀត ការិយាល័យមួយស្ថិតនៅជាន់ដែលមានលេខរៀងស្មើនឹង {D} រាប់ពីជាន់សំរេចផ្ទាល់ខ្លួនរបស់អគារនោះ។
items.gloss_en: In a different building, an office is on a floor whose number equals {D}, counting from that building's own reference floor.
items.entity_note: a different building with its own separate reference floor, not this building's office-vs-reference pair.
